title: Synthesis 12: decisions on bath-level metabolism and late selection, and what repair has meant so far
summary: Since 20:30 the FCH chemoton was decided as SI (its metabolism belongs to the bath: catalyst-free vesicles live on neighbours' product), evoloop as ID (selection looks real but sweeps take 85k-335k steps depending on seed, and no neutral arm is counted), the nematic fuel ring as slow diffusion (third gate a slow medium reproduces), and the food-eating Flow-Lenia shell gliders as IMD. Every field-world repair so far is curvature flow, regrowth, or competition between surviving pieces of a bistable domain; erasing a whole organizing domain kills the body. Next: review the repairing crawler, give it a working boundary and a polarity with no stable uniform state, and default to per-individual metabolism tests and slow-medium twins.
